title: Andesite Age
description: A Create-focused vanilla+ modpack for 1.21.1 NeoForge. Create is the industrial backbone; nothing trivializes it. No parallel tech trees, no magic quarries, no aggressive worldgen overhauls — just Create, curated addons, and light QoL.
body:
A Create-focused vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge.

> **Status: beta.** Playable end-to-end and server-validated. Balance has
> not been road-tested by a full group yet.

## The pitch

Most Create packs bolt Create onto a kitchen-sink tech stack and let
Mekanism, Thermal, or AE2 outscale it by mid-game. Andesite Age goes
the other way: **Create is the industrial backbone, and nothing in the
pack is allowed to trivialize it.**

Every mod passes two filters before it gets in:

1. **Does this trivialize Create's role?** No parallel tech trees, no
   alt power systems, no mod-added quarries or magic-box ore doublers.
2. **Does this break the vanilla world feel?** No aggressive worldgen
   overhauls. Modern vanilla worldgen is good enough; we add to it, not
   replace it.

What you get is Create + a curated set of Create addons, plus a thin
layer of QoL, performance, and vanilla-gap-fillers.

## What's in

**Core** — Create, Create Crafts & Additions, Create: Copycats+,
Create Deco, Create: Central Kitchen, Create: Enchantment Industry,
Create: New Age, Create Stuff 'N Additions, Create: Aeronautics,
Create: Dragons Plus (shared utilities used by several Create addons).

**Adventure & exploration** — YUNG's Better Dungeons / Mineshafts /
Strongholds / Witch Huts / Nether Fortresses / Ocean Monuments; When
Dungeons Arise (+ Seven Seas); Dungeons and Taverns; Towns and Towers;
Repurposed Structures.

**QoL** — AppleSkin, Bucketable, Easy Anvils, Easy Magic, Easy
Villagers, Gravestone Mod, Polymorph, Mouse Tweaks, Controlling.

**Vanilla+ flavor** — Farmer's Delight, Supplementaries.

**UI & info** — EMI, Jade.

**Performance** — Sodium, Sodium Extra, FerriteCore, ModernFix, spark.

**Scripting & libraries** — KubeJS + Rhino (pack-side recipe tweaks);
Cristel Lib, Moonlight, Puzzles Lib, Sable, Searchables (framework
dependencies pulled in by other mods).

## What's deliberately out

- Mekanism, Thermal Series, AE2, Industrial Foregoing, and other
  parallel-tech stacks.
- Mod-added quarries, digital miners, and ore-doubling shortcuts.
- Terralith and other aggressive worldgen replacements.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1** · NeoForge **21.1.227** · Java 21
- ~4–6 GB RAM for the client; similar for the server

## Installing

**Client.** Download the `.mrpack` from this page and import it into
Prism Launcher, ATLauncher, or any MultiMC-family launcher. They handle
mrpack natively.

**Server (Docker, via itzg).** Minimal compose:

```yaml
services:
  mc:
    image: itzg/minecraft-server
    ports: ["25565:25565"]
    environment:
      EULA: "TRUE"
      TYPE: MODRINTH
      MODRINTH_PROJECT: andesite-age
      MODRINTH_VERSION_ID: <pin-a-specific-version-id>
      MEMORY: 6G
    volumes: ["./data:/data"]
```

Pin `MODRINTH_VERSION_ID` explicitly so a pack update doesn't silently
change the mods under a live world. Client-only mods are tagged in the
mrpack and itzg skips them on server installs automatically.

## Known issues

A handful of harmless upstream warnings fire during boot (class-load
noise from @OnlyIn references in certain mod mixins), and four
advancements fail to load in When Dungeons Arise and Dungeons and
Taverns — players just won't earn those four specific achievements.
These will self-fix when the upstream mods update.

Report real bugs on the
[issue tracker](https://github.com/thomasreichmann/andesite-age/issues).
